display.title: Episode 368: The Return of Yehudah, Chapter 13 (Shabbos Zachor)
display.summary_short: A week before Purim: how the merit of 22,000 children saved the Jews, Shema with a pre-1A class, and Yehudah opens the secret message under the chuppah.
display.summary_long: Broadcast a week before Purim 5749. Uncle Yossi teaches that the Purim miracle came in the merit of small children: when Haman's decree became known, Mordechai gathered 22,000 children and taught them Torah, and today Tzivos Hashem gathers children to learn, give tzedakah and say the Twelve Pesukim. After the Hakochainik march, story time recaps The Return of Yehudah: Yehudah, now the town melamed, is chosen by the rav as his son-in-law. A pre-1A class from a Boro Park girls' school leads the Shema, and one girl recites a Yiddish poem about a mother lighting Shabbos candles. Back at the story, the whole town gathers for the wedding; under the chuppah Yehudah finally removes the secret note sewn into his tallis katan long ago, reads it, and stands speechless, while the gabbai's daughter Miriam quietly accepts that this match was not meant for her. The climax is promised for next week. The mailbox celebrates the 368th program and a listener's giant Shiviti drawing, and the show ends with reminders about Parshas Zachor, candle-lighting time, the Megillah, mishloach manos, matanos la'evyonim and the Purim seudah.
display.lesson: Children's Torah learning is the strongest weapon of the Jewish people; and whatever Hashem does is for the good.

date.note: Consistent with the audio: Parshas Zachor this Shabbos, candle lighting Friday 17 March, Megillah Monday night.
